# Rincon Hill demo district

The center is approximately the Spear Street / Infinity area. The district overlay is an illustrative selection bounds, not an official neighborhood boundary. Buildings use saved public OpenStreetMap geometry retrieved 2026-10-10 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright, ODbL). Attribution remains visible on the map.

Property records are deterministic simulated examples keyed by geometry ID. Unit layouts, prices, rent, HOA and amenities are fictional. They must not be attributed to Census or represented as current listings. 318 Spear Street is the geographic anchor; the individual stylized buildings are not precise address/unit matches. For actual background about The Infinity see https://infinitysf.org/infinity-facts/.
